quoted_language: 'sampling ICs with uniform distribution over rho in [0.0, 1.0] is highly skewed with respect to an unbiased distribution of ICs ... preliminary experiments indicated a need for such a biased distribution in order for the GA to make progress in early generations. This biased distribution turns out to impede the GA in later generations because, as increasingly fitter rules are evolved, the IC sample becomes less and less challenging for the GA.'
mundane_explanations: deliberate methodological choice, openly documented by the authors
status: LEAD -- the authors named a mechanism by which their own fitness measure degrades over a run
kill_observation: Unbiased-IC arms at matched compute show the same transition rate, i.e. the confound does not gate the phenomenon.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: This is a self-reported detector defect from 1994: the instrument gets less informative as the population improves. It is the direction-of-confound question the seat is required to ask, and it pushes AGAINST finding late-run innovation. A faithful reconstruction must carry it, and an unbiased-IC arm is the obvious first fork after Stage 1.

quoted_language: F_100 has a standard deviation of about 0.02; the authors identify this noise as the impediment preventing the GA from resolving GKL-quality rules. GKL-like particle behaviour was found at Hamming distances of 30+ bits from GKL when seeded with GKL mutants.
kill_observation: Raising I so the noise floor drops below 0.004 does not change the transition rate.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: A measurement-resolution limit that the original authors diagnosed themselves and could not afford to remove. Raising I is exactly the cheap modern intervention, and it is a rare case where the historical team named the fix they could not buy.

quoted_language: EvEmComp (PNAS 92:10742-10746, 1995) Table 1 prints the maj row as 000101170117177701171777177f7fff; the majority rule requires 000101170117177f0117177f177f7fff.
where: EvEmComp.pdf Table 1, maj row, hex positions 15 and 23
mundane_explanations: typesetting error in the printed table
status: CONFIRMED by independent first-principles derivation by the seat
kill_observation: N/A - this is a verified defect in a published specimen, not a candidate phenomenon.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: A reconstruction taking its majority baseline from the PNAS table would have run a rule that is not the majority rule while calling it one. Harmless for the reported result (maj scores 0.000 either way) but it is exactly the class of defect that silently corrupts a reconstruction. Execution beats transcription.
demonstration: Hex positions 15 and 23 cover neighbourhood indices 60-63 and 92-95. All eight have popcount >= 4 of 7, so majority must output 1 for all, requiring nibble f not 7. Neighbourhood 0111100 (index 60, popcount 4) settles it alone.

quoted_language: The recovering agent reported that rule particle2 shows performance RISING with lattice size, which would be backwards for a particle-based strategy.
mundane_explanations: the agent's own scoring convention or a transcription slip in its own measurement
status: NOT REPRODUCED. The seat measures 0.750 / 0.695 / 0.694 at N=149/599/999: normal monotone degradation. Anomaly attributed to the agent, not the rule. particle2 retained at high confidence.
kill_observation: Already killed: independent measurement shows no such scaling.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: The seat verifying its own subagent. An agent's reported anomaly is a LEAD, exactly like a historical paper's reported anomaly, and gets the same treatment. Had this been accepted, a sound recovered genome would have been flagged as doubtful.

quoted_language: Naive pdftotext -layout extraction mis-pairs the continuation rows of a printed rule table, moving each rule's second hex row onto the following rule's line; and evca-review.pdf has a broken Computer Modern ligature map rendering ff as a single glyph.
mundane_explanations: ordinary PDF text-extraction limitations on two-column typeset tables
status: CONFIRMED and defeated. Resolved three independent ways (character coordinates, table mode, execution), all agreeing.
kill_observation: N/A - methodological hazard, not a candidate phenomenon.
WHY_IT_MATTERS: Both hazards produce SYNTACTICALLY VALID but WRONG data rather than an obvious failure. The seat confirmed the discriminating power directly: deliberately mis-pairing par's first row with exp's second yields a rule scoring 0.010, effectively dead. This generalises to any recovery of a printed table from a 1990s PDF, and is the reason EXECUTION is the only trustworthy transcription check.
